second_order: testing whether April Fools reveals are real
theme_note: Participants test disputed reveal claims by estimating production effort, comparing dates across countries, warning one another, bringing outside reports, and circulating a clarification or live stream; what varies is the sign used and how provisional their belief remains.

second_order: hoping an elaborate joke becomes a playable game
theme_note: Participants make the reveal matter by hoping fanfare turns it into a return, describing an effortful joke as more painful, and weighing an existing Fightcade option against a modern release with training mode; what varies is whether they voice hope, disappointment, or desired features.

second_order: reacting to the banner scare and asking to keep it
theme_note: Participants respond to the rooms own banner joke by calling out the scare, predicting it may become real, laughing at its character pairing, praising it, and asking that it remain; reactions vary from mock alarm to approval and retention.

second_order: joining calls to draw Street Fighter characters
theme_note: Participants recruit or join hands-on attempts to put Ryu or Chun-Li on the canvas: opening calls name characters and coordinates, while replies report work, a placed dot, or willingness to contribute; targets and degree of participation vary.

second_order: simplifying Ryu around limited colors and a hadouken
theme_note: Participants revise the proposed Ryu into an easier target, adapt hands and shading to the available colors, and reuse an existing hadouken; what varies is whether simplification concerns the figure, palette, or already drawn material.

second_order: working out why Ryu will not stay up and asking the neighbours
theme_note: Participants try to locate a missing Ryu, tentatively diagnose erasure, report immediate replacement, and weigh more people against contacting or getting approval from maintainers of the territory underneath; the practice ranges from diagnosis to proposed negotiation, without evidence that permission was obtained.

second_order: spotting and thanking Brazil for making Blanka
theme_note: Participants notice Brazil making Blanka elsewhere on the canvas and report thanking them; the two codes belong together as recognition followed by appreciation, while no reply from Brazil is visible.
